name: Sepulchrine-Yardang
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a subterranean ocean, and everything the light never reaches.

Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
the buried megastructure still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on fusion fuel, water and medicinal compounds are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
